messages:
Marco: quick sync — finalizing v2 Canary tomorrow. owners: @Priya (SDK), @Kevin (routing), @Jenna (canary infra). need a short ack and any blockers by EOD.
Priya: acked. SDK team plan: bump client default to v2 on 2026-04-05, but we will keep automatic fallback header for 3 weeks. raising one PR to add feature-flag and docs. pinging reviewers. :+1:
Kevin: routing: we've got region fallback and variant routing ready. question: should canary traffic be 5% globally or 10% in us-west first? leaning us-west 10% to limit blast radius.
Jenna: infra ok with us-west 10%. will enable circuit-breaker thresholds and an auto-rollback hook. deploy-bot will run health checks every 30s.
Marco: let's do us-west 10% then gradual ramp. Priya — make sure SDK exposes opt-out env var and logs when falling back to v1. we want metrics for fallback rate.
Priya: yep, exposing REDWOOD_SDK_FORCE_V1 and REDWOOD_SDK_REPORT_FALLBACK=true. sample shim request header we'll add to docs: `X-Redwood-Client-Version: v2; fallback:on`
Kevin: quick routing snippet for canary policy: ```
- rule: if region == 'us-west' and variant == 'stable' -> route:v2-canary weight:10
- else -> route:v2-stable weight:90
```
Jenna: deploy-bot: starting canary in 15m. health probes: 2xx rate > 99% and p95 latency < 180ms for 5 consecutive minutes to continue. ops-bot will post alerts to #incidents on breach.
deploy-bot: canary start scheduled at 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z. auto-rollback on >=3% error rate sustained for 2m.
Sara: small note — docs team needs the deprecation copy. want to call out v1 sunsetting timeline? legal asked for 60 days notice after SDK flip. recommend target public deprecation announcement 2026-04-20.
Marco: good call. Priya/Jenna/Kevin confirm we can provide fallback metrics and rollback logs by Tuesday?
Priya: will ship the SDK PR today and include telemetry keys.
Kevin: routing PR in review, will merge after one more LGTM.
Jenna: infra checklist done, will attach runbook to the PR and set the rollback playbook.
Marco: perfect. if anyone hits a blocker ping this thread. post-deploy we'll do a quick async postmortem summary in #eng. thanks all :rocket:
